He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”
Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus…

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him, and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,
translations.bsb: This man was listening to the words of Paul, who looked intently at him and saw that he had faith to be healed.
translations.kjv: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
translations.asv: The same heard Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes upon him, and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,
